items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) was a full participant Wednesday, his first full practice since the injury, and practiced again Thursday; Rapoport says he is expected to play. The schedule data lists Tyler Huntley, so the model uses Jackson.

Baltimore: S Kyle Hamilton and LB Roquan Smith (knees) returned to practice Thursday after sitting Wednesday; rookie RG Vega Ioane (MCL sprain) also returned but his availability is uncertain. S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) did not practice Wednesday; LT Ronnie Stanley and G John Simpson were limited. OLB Tavius Robinson is out for the season. Final designations Friday.

Buffalo (Wednesday): RT Spencer Brown (back) did not practice; WR DJ Moore (shoulder), DT Ed Oliver (knee), TE Dalton Kincaid (chest), OLB Bradley Chubb (chest/thumb) and CB Dee Alford (ankle) were limited. S C.J. Gardner-Johnson is suspended for this game.
